description: Answers one finding on the staff list, as the finding's own answer does. set_reach saves a phone or sign-in email on the person and their linked contact (field phone or email, value). unlink_contact takes a contact off the person (contact_id). relink_contact moves a contact to another person (contact_id, to_staff_id). mark_reviewed records that a finding was reviewed (review_key from the finding, e.g. possible_duplicate:<id>). Taking someone off the team is the owner's, on the staff page. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: staff_identity_answer
title: Answer a staff identity finding
